feed_urls.label: Feed URLs
feed_urls.description: One RSS or Atom feed URL per entry (e.g. https://example.com/feed.xml).

refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often feeds are checked for new items.

notify_new.label: Notify on new items
notify_new.description: Show a notification for each new item found in the feeds.

max_notifications_per_cycle.label: Max notifications per cycle
max_notifications_per_cycle.description: Avoids a flood of notifications when many new items appear at once.

glyph.label: Icon
glyph.description: Icon shown in the bar for this widget.
